exploit_name: Division-by-zero in long-leg collateral for tight tick spacing
description: For tickSpacing == 1 pools, a 1-tick-wide long leg evaluated at its strike tick yields distanceFromStrike = 0, causing division-by-zero.
attack_scenario: Attacker holds 1-tick long at strike T. When current tick reaches T, liquidation reverts, preventing position closure.
root_cause: For tickSpacing == 1 pools, a 1-tick-wide long leg evaluated at its strike tick yields distanceFromStrike = 0, causing division-by-zero.
fix_description: Clamp distance to minimum: distanceFromStrike = Math.max(1, distanceFromStrike).
notes: Liquidation and force-exercise blocked at specific price points, potentially trapping insolvent positions.
